state_reviews.saved_state_qualification: Saved support/vertex interpretation and original body scatter only; no Hu reconstruction, hyperstress recovery, force-kernel, tangent, HP, equilibrium, energy-gradient, pressure or effective-grip qualification

interpretation.Q1_original_pattern: Both saved states report exact numeric [+,-,+,-] internal Hu vertex patterns on 722 original support cells each. This is a statement about original eight force values, not byte/signed-zero equality and not a recalculation from Hu or J.
interpretation.ON_body_sign_and_units: ON-body is the negative original internal local covector at selected fixed-body vertices. Nonselected displayed negative covectors are not applied physical body loads. Values are signed N with original thickness already included.
interpretation.side_pair_and_body: All four body/bottom_owner/left_owner/right_owner group resultants are saved as [0,0] in both states. The Q1 pattern permits exact opposite selected adjacent endpoints and complete-four-vertex cancellation under common translation. This does not make the separate assembled node forces or physical side-node categories zero.
interpretation.corner_only: The two one-selected-vertex corner_only owner cells retain the saved whole local Hu action. Saved local-minus-corner_only and five-role-minus-local differences are [0,0] in both states. These are descriptive saved cross-projection differences, not new exact-physics gates. Corner-only owners are not synonymous with macroscopic physical-corner nodes.
interpretation.visible_local_example: Cell10407 has opposite selected TR/TL vectors in both states, including Fy +/-0.012047321585135324 N at loading0.85mm. Its zero cell resultant coexists with nonzero contributions at the assembled boundary nodes. No couple or face-pressure value is inferred or calculated.
interpretation.partition_difference: The five owner roles partition local occurrences. The seven original node categories partition assembled body nodes. Physical-corner category HuFy is saved as 0.012892696672903312 N at state6 and 0.002496536054928965 N at state13, whereas corner_only role HuFy is 0.0011575021871015807 and 0.0012668445429290084 N respectively. These are different projections, so they cannot be merged or compared as two implementations of the same category.
interpretation.signed_material_Hu_total_effect: State6 original bottom_side_interior totalFy=-0.008963348606777537 N, materialFy=+0.0028308820398277763 N, HuFy=-0.011794230646605314 N. The original physical_corner category has positive total/material/Hu Fy. These saved signs demonstrate local redistribution/cancellation; they do not establish negative pressure, penetration, solver failure or mesh instability.
interpretation.original_scatter_evidence_limit: Each state reports one preserved original C-order internal scatter then negate on 1406 body DOFs, or703 body nodes, numeric-exact against original Hu nodes. The two-state output has1406 node rows. This supports provenance/addition-order consistency of saved body forces, not a new full-force-kernel replay, independent physical validation or continuous boundary traction recovery.
interpretation.two_L1_rules: The old original-node whole error uses original node Hu L1. The new selected-local whole and per-node regroup errors use original selected local Hu L1. Both are saved8eps bounds with no absolute floor. Both state old whole errors are[0,0]; state6 new whole error[0,-2.168404344971009e-19] and state13[3.2526065174565133e-19,-2.168404344971009e-19] are already saved within their corresponding bounds. No bound was recalculated or widened.
interpretation.energy_and_boundary_limit: Original exp(-5J) scaling belongs to the implemented non-potential weak force, not a naive total Hu stored-energy gradient. Vertex covectors do not uniquely split into adjacent physical-face pressures. This result does not recover a canonical hyperstress, boundary trace, stress jump, continuous DivP, energy derivative or actual face flux.

nearest_function_route.keep_and_reuse: Existing total/material/Hu response API, half/mirror reporting, actual24-frame deformation and nodal-component GIF, original48 HP body-force references and the new two-state Hu interpretation.
nearest_function_route.meaningful_remaining_gap: Task-consistent physical stability/usable-domain evidence for fixed-body response and candidate comparisons. Global Hu cancellation does not establish small local regularization influence; original node signs justify retaining signed total/material/Hu and local deformation/clearance diagnostics.
nearest_function_route.coarse_route_only: First reconcile existing same-design h1/h0.5 and prior regularization experiments under one physical-task contract; choose one genuinely missing minimal mesh or regularization factor, not several simultaneous changes. Use already implemented response/view functions. This review sets no new h, parameter, path, HP count, gate, resource or execution card.
nearest_function_route.pressure_dependency: Formal total-pressure or effective-grip reporting requires a compatible boundary/Hu definition and independent physical evidence; this should not block reuse of already reportable fixed-body weak loads.
nearest_function_route.avoid_repetition: No need to redo full24-state ledgers, original Hu/DD reconstruction, duplicate viewer or repeated same body-force HP projections merely to restate this explained partition difference.
